text: XL Magma Sautés are Veggies in . They can be created by Jin at Campsites. The recipe for making this item is obtained as a reward for completing the quest Hungry for More.

Yanchik Harbor (Japanese: , Yajika no Minato) is a landmark in . It is located at the northernmost tip of the Lasaria Region in the Kingdom of Torna. There are Obstructive roots here which require Level 3 Swift Swordplay and Level 3 Focus Field Skills to remove to access a Barney Stone. There are also several Treasure Troves and the Rusty Slate Piece. The quests A Simple Errand, Barmy Tale of Barney, Driver Coaching and A Rare Sense of Justice may be accepted here.

Wrackham Moor (Japanese: , Rakina Gen'ya) is a location in . It is an open plain located just south of Aletta: Militia Garrison in the Aletta Region, adjacent to Lake Sarleigh and the Tirkin Cliff Colony. There is an ether miasma here, and the Golden Monster Herculean Gibson after purchasing its location from the Nopon Halfsage. Three Preoccupied Gogols must be fought here during the Story Quest Lett Bridge Restoration.

Xenoblade 2: Official Artworks - Alrest Records is an artbook released in Japan, with illustrations for Xenoblade Chronicles 2 and Torna ~ The Golden Country. The cover was illustrated by Masatsugu Saito and features four special artworks by CHOCO, the character designer for Theory, Praxis, and T-elos, as well as the character designer for many of the Xenosaga games. The artbook features official art for the characters, rare Blades, weapons, Titans, monsters, objects, etc. It also includes all the Heart-to-Heart and battle dialogues, as well as developer interviews.

Youse Parisaxes (Japanese: , Yūsu Parasu) are enemies in . They are members of the Parisax family and can be found at level 34 - 41 throughout the Tornan Titan Interior of the Kingdom of Torna, particularly at the Crooked Tower, Pantarhei Tower and spawning from Titan Antibody Cores.
Winterwind Perfumes are Fragrance items in . It can be created by Brighid at Campsites.

Xane Pippitos (Japanese: , Zain Pipitto) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family, and can be found at level 33-40 at Coolley Lake, Seigle Fell, and Nebley Wind Cave in Gormott. One must be defeat to unlock Haze's Level 4 Cloudburst.

Yokuyoku is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can initially be found in Acheron Backstreet in Auresco in the Kingdom of Torna, and later at the Aletta: Militia Garrison. He is one of the "Four Muskerpon", a group of Nopon brothers containing Rooroo, Komemi and Kachakacha who all share one Community portrait (he is on the left). He is involved during the quests Forest Trail Antics and Making Up the Numbers, and his Community is gained upon completion of the latter alongside Luc and Vronka. During Forest Trail Antics, Yokuyoku can be found atop the Aquila Watchtower.

Yrissa is an NPC in . She is a Tornan shopkeeper who can be found at Formide Shopping Ward in the Kingdom of Torna. She runs the Capital Accessories shop, and is Ofa's granddaughter. Her Community is gained upon completion of Forest Trail Antics alongside Ofa's, and she gives no Quests herself.
Yarmos is an NPC in . She is a Tantalese who is found at Elmos Square in the Kingdom of Tantal.

(Japanese: , Tsunagaru mirai) is an extra epilogue story extension of . It revolves around Melia, accompanied by Shulk and two new Nopon, Kino and Nene, who are all playable in the new area Bionis' Shoulder. This additional story can be played without clearing the main storyline first (although it will not make sense without prior knowledge of the plot).

(Japanese: ) is a role-playing video game published by Nintendo and developed by Monolith Soft for the Nintendo Switch. It is a remastered port of the original . The game was announced at the end of the Nintendo Direct presentation on September 4, 2019. The game was released worldwide on May 29, 2020.

Xen's Thoroughfare (Japanese: , Zen no Dōmon) is a landmark in . It is a large artificial archway located on the Bionis' Shoulder, reachable by following the northern plateau across the river of Cinnabar Plateau. There are no enemies at the landmark itself; those listed here occur between Cinnabar Plateau and the landmark point, where there is also a Pororo's Favourite. Shoulderstone Scree lies immediately west.

Wunwun (Japanese: , Wanawana) is a Nopon in . He is the Ponspector chief and member of the red team met at Gran Dell on the Bionis' Shoulder, where he has been waiting to rendezvous with the rest of his team. Despite having only been Ponspecting for three years, Wunwun is proud to be the chief of the Ponspectors and is constantly working to improve its reputation. He is rather forgetful at times. He also does not wish to make his colleagues worry and hides information that may prove demoralising from them. He is the only Ponspector to offer two quests, although as Tentoo gives none this still amounts to one per Ponspector by number.

The World Ender is a weapon in . It is a staff wielded by Melia, obtained upon starting the game. It has a unique Appearance.

According to Tetsuya Takahashi, the music is faithful to the spirit but integrates a flute-based melody as its motif where this instrument is one of the key themes in the game. Wira Nos are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Droids, and can be found at level 65-67 at Ferronis Arsenal #1, Ferronis Arsenal #3, the South Sector Passage, and the Hangar, Upper Level in the Origin Interior.

Wira Zoonos are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Droids, and can be found at level 65-67 at Ferronis Arsenal #1, Ferronis Arsenal #3, the South Sector Passage, and the Hangar, Upper Level in the Origin Interior.

X∞ (Japanese: エックス∞) is a Boss in . It is a Moebius fought at level 75 in Origin. During the battle, only Noah, Lanz, and Eunie will be usable. The equipped Hero may also be available during the battle, which will prevent that Hero from participating in the fight against Y∞. This enemy is fought during the second phase of the final Boss fight against Z∞. Several Heroes (except for DLC Heroes) are summoned by Melia and Nia to aid the party when X∞ uses Meaningless Pain for the first time. Whenever the player uses a Talent Art, a random Hero will follow up with their own Talent Art. Once defeated, the rest of the party will fight Y∞.

Y∞ (Japanese: ) is a Boss in . It is a Moebius fought at level 75 in the Origin after defeating X∞. During the battle, only Mio, Sena, and Taion can be used. If the current Hero doesn't participate in the battle against X∞, they will be usable in this battle. Additionally, several other random Heroes (except for DLC Heroes) will also by summoned by Nia and Melia to aid the party in fighting against Y∞ when the battle begins. Whenever the player uses a Talent Art, a random Hero will follow up with their own Talent Art. After Y∞ is defeated, the party will fight Z∞ for the last time.
Yarmil is an NPC in who can be found in the Great Sword's Base.
Xera (Japanese: , Shuuri) is an NPC in who can be found in Agnus Castle.

The Yum-Yum Coconut is a Key Item in . It is a giant coconut that is found on Daedal Isle during Doing It My Way.

Yellowgrove Kelp Mushrooms are Collectible items in . Three can be found in the Yellowgrove of High Maktha Wildwood during Stolen Provisions. After collecting them, Taion realizes that they are not Kelp Mushrooms, but actually Naiti-Naits.
Wolder Caterpiles are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Caterpile family, and can be found at level 61 on Lavi Sandbar in Erythia Sea.
Yunnae Feris are three Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Feris family that are fought at level 52 at Yunnae's Rise on Elaice Highway during Alexandria's Birthday.
Wintry End (Japanese: , Sunōendo) is a Chain Art in . It is Ethel's Chain Art during a Chain Attack.

Young Vollgulls are Normal Minor Enemies in . Although they are members of the Vollgull family, they are visually and functionally members of the Rhogul family, and can be found at level 40 on Raguel Bridge on The Ragmos Desolation after hatching from Vollgull Eggs. They drop rare Nutrient-Rich Vollgull Eggs.

Yggdrasil is a Field Track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track one on disc five from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track one on disc ten from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays in the World Tree. Motifs from Elysium, in the Blue Sky are used in multiple parts of the song.

It is track three of disc five from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track three of disc ten from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It uses a motif from Elysium, in the Blue Sky. This track plays during the following moments in : * Mythra and Malos fighting during the Aegis War. * Amalthus climbing the World Tree and finding the Aegis cores. * Lora awakening Jin. * Mythra stating her belief that Malos is damaged during the leaders summit in the Indoline Praetorium. * King Eulogimenos ordering Pyra's destruction. * The party observing a battleground from the Aegis War near the Genbu Crown

Yoko Shimomura (Japanese: , Shimomura Yōko) is a composer of video game music. She has been active since 1988 and worked for Capcom, where she has earned popularity thanks to her music writing on Street Fighter II along with Isao Abe in 1991. Then she joined Square before becoming a freelance composer in 2002. She is one of the composers of the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack, including the Xenoblade Chronicles Special Soundtrack.

Xenoblade Chronicles X Collector's Guide is an English-language strategy guide for Xenoblade Chronicles X. It was released in North America, the UK, and Australia. In North America it was released on the same date as the game. The publisher has stated that it will only have a single print run. An electronic edition is also be available. According to the publisher the guide will include a detailed walkthrough of the game, tips for customizing the player's character and Skell, combat tactics, and "all the secrets in the game". Zazadan (Japanese: ) is a Nopon in . He can be found in the Nopon Refuge in Satorl Marsh. He is a crafter of Red Pollen Orbs and a pawn to Bana. Once Gather Information has been completed, Zazadan will disappear so it will be impossible to meet him again in the same playthrough.

Zilex (Japanese: , Riretto) is a Machina in . He is Miqol's secretary, and can be found next to him inside the Junks on the Fallen Arm.

Zel Argentis (Japanese: , Zeru Shirubā, Zel Silver) is a High Entia NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles. She is the sister of En Argentis and the daughter of Don Argentis. She can be found in Alcamoth, southeast of the Fountain of Hope, in front of the large fountain at the bottom of the southernmost escalator, from about 20:00 to 03:00. After the events at the Mechonis Core, if she has not been migrated to Colony 6, she can be found in Satorl Marsh at the Sororal Statues, not far from the pod, on the eastern edge of the platform. At Colony 6, she can be found in the Housing Level 5 area overlooking the lake at 17:00.

Zazadan in Danger (Japanese: , Madamada Bussou) is a quest in . It can be received from Zazadan in the Nopon Refuge in Satorl Marsh. It is the second in a series of five quests that can be received from Zazadan. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment.

Zazadan Still in Danger (Japanese: , Mada Bussou) is a quest in . It can be received from Zazadan in the Nopon Refuge in Satorl Marsh. It is the third in a series of five quests that can be received from Zazadan. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.
Zax Guidepost (Japanese: , Zakusu no Dо̄hyо̄) is a landmark in . It is located on the upper level of Bionis' Leg, in the the northwest corner. It is very similar in appearance to Kamos Guidepost.

Zaldania Waterfall (Japanese: , Zatanarugia no Taki) is a location in . It is located in Satorl Marsh, east of the Nopon Merchant Camp and north of the Poison Swamp. There is a good chance of finding Forget-You-Nots here. A Heart-to-Heart - "The Shimmering Marsh" - is located here.
Z Speed Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Z Attack Goggles (Japanese: , Z Atakku Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in .
Z Speed Goggles (Japanese: , Z Supīdo Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Zakt Spring (Japanese: , Zakuto no Izumi) is a location in . It is a small spring on the lower level of Fallen Arm, south of the Wreckage Beach. This is where Shulk must collect the Clean Water for Fiora when they first arrive on the Fallen Arm, and the Pure Water for the quest The Wilted Flower. There are no enemies nearby.

Zealous Arachnos (Japanese: , Shūnen no Supaido) are five quest exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 11 in a cavern near Vilia Lake in Tephra Cave during Clearing Obstructions, where three of them must be defeated.

Zero Gravity (Japanese: , Gurabitī Zero) is one of Fiora's Ether arts in . Fiora unleashes a gravity field that may inflict Paralysis to targets centered around her. It also fills Fiora's Talent Gauge by 25% for each Toppled enemy hit by this attack.

Zanza Guardians (Japanese: , Zanza Gādian) are a special category of enemy in . They are an unknown species and are summoned by Zanza. They are all sight story exclusive enemies only found at Sentient Genesis in Memory Space during the final boss battle. There are three variants of Zanza Guardians.

Zedonia Plaza (Japanese: , Zedonia Hiroba) is a location in . It is located on the second floor of Agniratha, near the Meyneth Statue and the Telethia Bridge. The Wise Gremory and the Meditative Varla can be found here, which are needed for the quests Military Status 1 - 2 and Military Status 2 - 1 respectively.
Zazadan's Memo is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received from Zazadan during Gather Information, and must be delivered to Gadada during Adviser Hunt.

Zanza the Divine (ザンザ, Zanza) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 14 of disc 2 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is a pre-battle theme that is heard in cutscenes prior to the first two battles against Zanza, and also serves as the battle theme for both of those fights as well. It is also heard during the first battle against the Fog King in .

Zanza's World (ザンザの世界で, Into the World of Zanza) is a Field Track in Xenoblade Chronicles, composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 24 of disc 4 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is heard in battle against Spirit enemies in Memory Space. As such, there are only four enemies in the game for whom this theme will play: Spirit - Mumkhar, Spirit - Xord, Spirit - Telethia, and Spirit - Gadolt.
Zero Zero is one of Celica's two Signature Arts in . Cross learns this art after completing her Affinity Mission Fitting In.

z5m20i12r04a28 is a track in Xenoblade Chronicles X composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano. It is track two of disc two from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack. The first half of this track is heard when Cross is introduced to the wilderness of Primordia, and is a remix of NightL. The second half is heard in the following cutscenes: * The start of the Ganglion invasion in Chapter 8 * Mia gets captured by the Falconine Jacul in Mighty Mia * De Soghu's appearance in Leaving the Nest

The Zu Pharg (English dub: ) (Japanese: , Zu Haggu) is a massive Ganglion war machine and a Main Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is placed within its own subcategory in the Enemy Index. It is piloted by Ryyz and Dagahn. The party encounters it at level 39 in Sylvalum during Chapter 10 after a Data Probe repair job. The first phase of the battle takes place near Delusians North Summit, while the second phase takes place at the Zu Pharg Interception Line. The Zu Pharg can summon various Ganglion mechs during both phases, including Qmoevas, Galdr, and Fal-swos. For the second phase of the battle, the Zu Pharg transforms into a four-legged mode and deals beam-attribute proximity spike damage.

Zesian Fleaworts (Japanese: , Zezeoobako, Zeze Plantain) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, near Biahno Lake. Four of them are needed for Herbivores, Unite!.

The Zu Pharg Interception Line (Japanese: , Zu Haggu Geigeki Rain) is a story exclusive landmark in . It is located in Sylvalum, south of the bridge near FN Site 412. It is the site of the second phase of the battle against the Zu Pharg, after in transforms into its true form.

Zo Fwar (Japanese: , Zo Fuwa) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a level 44 Wrothian and is fought alongside Ga Buidhe and Zo Borri at the entrance to the Oblivia's Wrothian Stronghold during A Challenger Approaches.

Zo Borri (Japanese: , Zo Bori) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a level 44 Wrothian and is fought alongside Ga Buidhe and Zo Fwar at the entrance to the Oblivia's Wrothian Stronghold during A Challenger Approaches.
Zeedoy is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found in the Central Industrial District of New Los Angeles.
Zurranik is a NPC in and . He can be found near the Deck inside the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.
Zandemo Eggplants (Japanese: , Zandemo Nasu) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum.
Zizi Rabbits (Japanese: , Jījīrabi) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia. Three are required for the Basic Mission Rabbit Research.
Zedis Twigs (Japanese: , Zedisu no Koeda) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia. Three are required for Booming Business.
Zalon Dirts (Japanese: , Zaruron no Doro) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, near Mount M'gando and in Cauldros Waters.

Zagyrin Cragstones (Japanese: , Zagirin Genseki) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular near FN Site 504. One is needing for The Unbreakable Sword.
Zdenka, the Raucous (, Kensō no Zudenka) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Saltat family. It can be found at level 60 atop a tower on Fallshorn Isle in Primordia.

Zorn, the Wanderer (, Rurō no Sorun) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Saltat family. It can be found at level 56 at the back of the Old Ceremonial Hollow in Cauldros during a rainbow, which has a chance to occur following brimstone rain.

Zohan, the Thunderbolt (Japanese: , Raikō no Zōn) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Scintimure family. It can be found at level 64 in the sky above the large spiked tree at the southern end of the Delusians North Summit in Sylvalum, only during Spores weather.

The Zaruboggan (Japanese: , Zarubokka) are a race of beings in . Their homeworld, Bedun, is covered in dense toxins which they call voltant (English dub: ), a substance which is necessary for their survival but harmful to all other lifeforms. They are humanoid, but wear bulky clothes and helmets resembling hazmat suits which hide their true appearance. According to Orleron they are not divided into genders and reproduce asexually; the Affinity Chart lists the "gender" field of all Zaruboggan as "Unknown". Despite this Chiromyl is implied to be female or at least have a female personality of sorts. The Zaruboggan worship a god named Golbogga (English dub: ), who according to Trachlo Lythren "

Zeppelin Germivores (Japanese: , Sorento Burōsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Germivore family, and can be found at level 21-30 in Primordia, northwest of FN Site 108.
Zo Zazhi (Japanese: , Zo Zaji) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Wrothian and can be found in the east part of the Commercial District of New Los Angeles at night.

Zirconium Fal-swos (Japanese: , Jirukon Gi-suo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Fal-swo machines, and can be found at level 52-57 in Oblivia's Jair Fortress and level 59 above the Cryptic Sign.
Zu Pharg Wreckage is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. These parts are scattered around the northern part of Noctilum and must be gathered during Waste Not, Want Not.

Ziggian Long Antennae are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Zigs. They are components in I-V Critical Chance Up and CriticalUp augments. Two are required for Skell Repair: Antenna.
Zazazan (Japanese: , Zazazan) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Nopon and can be found on the Emerian Battlegrounds in Cauldros. He has a bodyguard named Harvey.
z7b2012lp0427arr is a track in Xenoblade Chronicles X, composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano. It is track fifteen of disc two in the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack.
Zo Ozuchi (Japanese: , Zo Ozuchi) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian who can be found at the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.

The Zeulbe Caladar (Japanese: , Zeureba Kakara) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the Caladar Skell piloted by Da Zeulbe fought at level 42 in Stickstone Rise in Primordia during The Queen Is Dead.
Zo Geil is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian, and can be found in the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia during the day.
Zarch Quokett (Japanese: , Zahha Kokēto) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles during the night.

The Zealot Glennar (Japanese: , Īga Gurennā) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Prone Ganglion, and can be found at level 29 at Ensconced Citadel in Noctilum. He must be defeated during Bozé's Way.
Zo Langra (Japanese: , Zo Ranga) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian, and can be found in the east part of the Commercial District of New Los Angeles at night.
Zo Zinath (Japanese: , Zo Jinate) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian, and can be found at the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia at night.

Zazazan's Package is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It's obtained after defeating Harvey, the two BLADE Troopers and the Faded Nopopotamus inside the Den of the Dead in Sylvalum during Special Delivery.

The Zweihand-Q is a superweapon for Skells in . It is known as Gravity-Sword in the Japanese version.

Zig B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a gray zig variant with spherical arms. It can be obtained from silver drops from Enhanced Search Zig in Cauldros.

Zig D is a Holofigure in . It depicts a gray zig variant with semi-circle shaped arms. It can be obtained from silver drops from Enhanced Support Zig in Cauldros.

Zig G is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white and blue zig variant with shield-like arms. It can be obtained from silver drops from Enhanced Attack Range Zig in Cauldros.

The Zirtodiamond is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It must be retrieved from Sylvalum's Hilal Stronghold during the Normal Mission The Old Gods.

Zo Zongra (Japanese: , Zo Zonga) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a level 38 Wrothian and is fought alongside Gi Bordo, Da Dorde, Gu Galda in Sylvalum during the squad mission The Wrothian Four.

His Highness the Crown Prince Ozychlyrus Brounev Tantal (Japanese: , Jīfurito Buryūne Rukusuria, Sîvrit Brunet Luxuria), better known as Zeke von Genbu (Japanese: , Jīku B Arutimetto Genbu, Zeke B Ultimate Genbu), is a Driver and one of the main playable characters in . He is accompanied by his Blade, Pandoria. They have a pet turtle who they call Turters. Zeke joins the party during Chapter 5, right before embarking to Temperantia. He is designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Zuzu is an NPC in . Zuzu is a Nopon who can be found at Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild. Zuzu runs a shop called Noodler's Delight specialized in Staple Foods.

Zeoth Serprond (Japanese: , Zeōsu Rodon) are enemies in . They are members of the Serprond family, and can be found at level 60 - 62 in Temperantia, in the Cloud Sea area south of the Ardainian Garrison.

Zeno's Deadbole (Japanese: , Kuchiki no Shima) is a landmark in . It is located at Coolley Lake on the right side of the upper level of Gormott Province. It is a giant hollow tree trunk, with a spring on the inside leading to the Clear Sky Beak. There are no enemies here.

Zalmor's Crevice (Japanese: , Zarumoa Kurebasu) is a location in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, south-east of the Sacred Grove. This location is involved during the quest Tender-Hearted Beast.

Ziggan Garluses (Japanese: , Zīgan Garuusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Garlus family, and can be found at level 49 - 55 at the Sacred Grove on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.
Zamban Urchons (Japanese: , Zanbā Unin) are enemies in . They are members of the Urchon family, and can be found at level 45-47 at the Elpys Great Hall on the Mid Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

Zero Barks are Tree collectibles in . They can be found in the First Low Orbit Station, in particular at the forestry Collection Point located next to a tree north west of the Hill Overlooking Elysium.

Zircon Chips are Core Chips in . They can only be obtained from one quest and three high level enemy drops. All weapons forged with a Zircon Chip deal 50% more damage against aerial creatures. Zircon Chips share their appearance with Garnet Chips, Opal Chips, and Aquamarine Chips. __TOC__

Zeld Rodonyas (Japanese: , Birudo Mūsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Rodonya family, and can be found at level 27-29 at the Valdorm's Mound, the Ruined Laborers' Bridge or the Old Industrial District, in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Perceval's level 3 Blade Vortex.
Zigul Tirkin (Japanese: , Zigeru Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 30-33 on Daram Isle and the Ansel Hatchery in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Zalts Drivers (Japanese: , Zarutsu Doraibā) are enemies in . They are Driver enemies. One can be found at level 31 on the northernmost path of the Lower Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain, alongside a Cheren Driver and a Kyth Driver.

Zooz Aspids (Japanese: , Zazanku Asupīdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Aspid family, and can be found at level 54-58 from the Salvage Points of the Canyon of Husks and the Portal of the Hero in the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

The Zohak Driver (Japanese: , Zohāku Doraibā) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . They are a Driver enemy fought at level 48 at Work Observation Tower in the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain, and then again in the Artificial Blade Adjustment alongside the Gardyll and Vallent Drivers during Eternal Spirit.

Zubzub is an NPC in . He is a Nopon salvager who can be found on the Salvage Deck in front of the Goldmouth Warehouse in the Argentum Trade Guild. He sells the Calamity Puzzle for 500,000 G required during Salvage King. He will not lower the price, and will disappear upon being paid. Zubzub offers no quests or Merc Missions.

Zenobia's Enemy 1 (Japanese: , Yaegiri - Kyōteki wo Motomete 1) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild automatically after Zenobia joins the party. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Electric Mastery" Field Skills. This mission unlocks Zenobia's Enemy 2 and the second row of Zenobia's Affinity Chart.

Zenobia's Enemy 2 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province after completing the mission Zenobia's Enemy 1. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ice Mastery" Field Skills. This mission unlocks Zenobia's Enemy 3 and the third row of Zenobia's Affinity Chart.

Zenobia's Enemy 4 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain after completing the mission Zenobia's Enemy 3. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fire Mastery" and "Wind Mastery" Field Skills. This mission unlocks the fifth row of Zenobia's Affinity Chart. After Zenobia's Enemy 1, Zenobia's Enemy 2 and Zenobia's Enemy 3 and this mission are completed, the Merc Mission We Need To Talk! will become available.

Zenobia's Enemy 3 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya after completing the mission Zenobia's Enemy 2. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Dark Mastery" and "Earth Mastery" Field Skills. This mission unlocks Zenobia's Enemy 4 and the fourth row of Zenobia's Affinity Chart.

Zengrid Catador is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found on a cliff above the Garfont Training Ground in the Kingdom of Uraya, if hired. He is one of three NPCs who can be hired as admin of the Garfont Mercenaries during the quest Leadership Qualities. He claims to be from a noble family of Fonsa Myma.

Zekor Lexos (Japanese: , Zakkēro Rekusosu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lexos family, and can be found at level 38 at Daridan's Stack or the Isle of Urchon in the Leftherian Archipelago after Salvaging.

The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes. Since it has no suggested Field Skills, its duration cannot be reduced. This mission permanently expires after defeating Pelagic Vincent, Telluric Desirée and Celestial Bailey in Merclibay Islet.

Zenma is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found at the Hidden Hunting Camp in Gormott. He gives the quest Seeking a Seeker, upon completion of which his Community is gained.

There are no enemies directly at the Counsel, but Highborn Alexandra, a Unique Monster, can be found immediately north.

Zoren (Japanese: ) is a NPC in who can be found in Colony 11.

Z - Harbinger of the End is a track from , composed by Manami Kiyota and Yasunori Mitsuda. Records carry over to , while Trials are based on things that are reset (such as the affinity chart) and so do not carry over. Very few are missable; the vast majority are not, though some can be made difficult. Achievements have a different description before and after they are completed. Usually the initial description is a vague hint for what to do, while the final one is a more exact description of what was done. A Dream of the Future is one of 's Battle Skills in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. The in-game description of this skill's effect is misleading in that it is not random at all. Instead, it allows Rex to manually modify Pneuma's s to be any that would continue the current Blade Combo, or any element if no combo has yet begun. If the player is controlling Rex, this is done by pressing up and down on the D-Pad to select a valid element (overriding the D-Pad's normal usage); elements that would not continue an existing Blade Combo cannot be selected. If controlled by the AI, Rex will attempt to pick an element that no one else has currently readied.
